name: Digital Creative Lab
blurb: An ITS lab with podcast studios, a production studio, an e-sports lab, plotters, a 3D printer, classrooms and study spaces. The podcast studio is booked by email.
hours_note: Podcast studio, fall and spring: Monday to Friday 9 AM to 7 PM, Saturday and Sunday 9 AM to 5 PM. Summer hours differ; see the official page. Hours for the rest of the lab are not listed.
access_steps: Email spaces@usc.edu to reserve the podcast studio, or call the ITS Learning Environments team at (213) 821-6601.
The e-sports lab is by reservation. The page does not say how to use the production studio, plotters or 3D printer, so ask the same team.

equipment.name: Podcast studio: 4 Shure headsets, a Rode mixer, a Huddly camera, an Epiphan recorder and a DTEN for Zoom
equipment.plain_name: Podcast studio (a room for recording audio)

equipment.name: Production studio
equipment.plain_name: Production studio (a room for recording video)

services.name: Technology orientation: instruction on specific equipment, on request
services.how_to_request: Submit a Request for Technology Orientation on the ITS Service Portal.

first_visit: You will likely need your USC ID.
estimates.training_note: 3D printing here is likely by request: staff typically run the printer for you, so you would need no training. Ask to be sure.
estimates.cost_note: You likely pay for materials only. Where this space lists no price, cost ranges use typical prices for buying the material yourself.
